blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–With the last three Philippine Golf Tour legs decided by a combined margin of four strokes, the ICTSI Iloilo Golf Challenge seems to be no different with the familiar faces showing up on a course that no one really has a lot of familiarity with. The tree-lined layout formerly known as Sta. Barbara—listed as the oldest golf course in the Far East—will be the battleground as the veterans and upcoming stars have all shown up for the 72-hole championship that offers a total purse of P2.5 million. Art Arbole has some momentum coming to Bacolod after breaking through last week […]... Keep on reading: Wide-open Iloilo PGT stop gets going at old Sta. Barbara layout
